title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes-from emerging brands to Fortune 500s-use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

The Enterprise Account Executive (ENT) is responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. This role owns advanced, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, and decision layers. The ENT AE operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.

Your responsibilities as an Account Executive, Enterprise include, but are not limited to the following:

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

• Own and close high-value, complex enterprise opportunities, consistently meeting or exceeding individual quotas.

• Build a strategic pipeline through self-prospecting, account planning, and SDR partnership.

• Proactively identify whitespace, expansion potential, and multi-entity opportunities within target accounts.

• Maintain forecasting, opportunity hygiene, and deal governance in Salesforce (SFDC).

Strategic Discovery & Solution Architecture

• Lead executive-level discovery to understand enterprise supply chain strategy, risk posture, and long-term business objectives.

• Navigate complex buying groups across procurement, ops, finance, IT, and senior leadership.

• Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and business outcomes.

• Position Flexport as a strategic partner through compelling value narratives, business cases, and solution roadmaps.

Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Closing

• Own end-to-end deal strategy for complex opportunities, including stakeholder mapping, decision criteria, and close plans.

• Lead advanced commercial negotiation, pricing, contracts, and non-standard deal structures.

• Orchestrate internal stakeholders (Ops, Finance, Legal, Product) to progress deals efficiently

Onboarding, Expansion & Relationship Leadership

• Own the onboarding motion, ensuring enterprise customers are set up for scalable success.

• Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

• Identify expansion opportunities together with Account Management to drive sustained growth.

• Serve as a point of escalation and strategic advisor during the customer lifecycle.

Enterprise Leadership & Market Impact

• Act as a senior commercial voice in enterprise pursuits, sharing market insight and customer feedback internally.

• Contribute to enterprise sales best practices, deal reviews, and peer coaching.

• Represent Flexport with credibility and confidence in high-stakes customer interactions.

You should have:

• 5+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise-level sales cycles with consistent quota attainment.

• Proven ability to close large, multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles and high deal complexity.

• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.

• Advanced discovery, negotiation, and value-based selling skills.

• High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and commercial judgment.

• Strong logistics, freight

title: Senior RF Systems Integration & Test Engineer
tags: Mission Systems : Electromagnetic Warfare Engineering : Electronic Warfare
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our  Electronic Warfare (EW) team is redefining how we dominate the electromagnetic spectrum. We’re moving away from slow, legacy defense hardware to build agile, software-defined EW systems that deploy real-time detection, geolocation, and defeat capabilities directly to the tactical edge.Based out of our Costa Mesa HQ, our team builds the hardware and software behind systems like  Pulsar -tackling high-stakes mission sets like Counter-UAS, Electronic Countermeasures (ECM), Direction Finding, and cognitive RF sensing in contested environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Senior Systems Integration & Test Engineer to drive the verification, automation, and operational deployment of our next-gen Electronic Warfare systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional hardware, software, firmware, and RF teams to lead integration testing across subassemblies and full systems. From designing robust automated test suites and analyzing system telemetry to rapid failure triage and root-cause diagnosis, you will be instrumental in ensuring system reliability. Additionally, you will serve as a technical liaison during system deployment, traveling to support internal and customer-facing flight tests and field demonstrations.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Develop and maintain system-level test strategies, procedures, and test plans for Anduril’s Electronic Warfare (EW) product lines.

• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams (hardware, software, firmware, and RF) to integrate and test new and existing EW products.

• Perform integration testing on subassemblies and full systems, spanning RF/digital hardware, firmware, embedded software, and application software layers.

• Design and implement automated tests to increase test coverage, repeatability, and overall testing efficiency.

• Triage and troubleshoot system-level failures observed during integration and characterization to rapidly identify root causes.

• Analyze system telemetry and test data to reproduce issues, validate software/hardware fixes, and ensure system reliability.

• Serve as a key technical liaison to deploy Anduril’s integrated hardware-software products, ensuring they meet customer and operational needs.

• Travel to support flight tests and system demonstrations at both internal and customer-facing sites, validating Anduril’s EW capabilities in real-world operational environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of relevant industry experience with a strong focus on hardware, software, and system-level verification and validation testing.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Highly proficient with RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and vector network analyzers.

• Comfortable navigating Linux environments, utilizing command-line interfaces, executing shell scripts, and working with debugging utilities.

• Experience using programming languages such as Python or MATLAB for data parsing, telemetry analysis, and test automation.

• Strong root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex, system-level issues.

• Ability to travel up t

title: Staff QE
description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the team

Every insight on AlphaSense is tied to a company. Reference Entity Data Services (REDS) owns the data that makes that possible: one trusted record for every company, connected across all the sources we bring in.

REDS turns records from many providers into one authoritative view, keeps it current, and supplies it to every part of the platform that depends on it, from search to company profiles. When that foundation is right, customers find the right company and trust what they see. 

About the Role

As the Staff Quality Engineer dedicated to REDS, you will define how we prove our data is correct before it reaches customers. You will set the strategy, build the practice from the ground up, and work closely with engineering and product leadership to make quality a measurable part of how the team ships.

What You'll Do

• Own the quality strategy for AlphaSense's company reference data, built on quality by design and automation by default.

• Close test coverage gaps on our critical workflows: ingesting provider data, matching records, keeping identifiers stable over time, and delivering entity data and change events to the product teams that rely on them.

• Define what "correct" means for company data, and build the golden datasets, labeled samples, and automated checks that prove it, including measuring match precision and recall and the tradeoff between false merges and false splits.

• Set the quality measures and release standards the team uses to ship with confidence.

• Build and grow scalable automation across our data, API, and event-driven interfaces, and decide what belongs at the unit, component, API, and E2E layers.

• Anticipate data lifecycle risks such as provider data drift, schema changes, and late or conflicting records, and build regression coverage for them.

• Partner with developers on test planning for new features, so automation is ready as the code is.

• Use production signals to focus effort where it reduces the most risk to customers.

• Bring AI into how the team designs, maintains, and triages tests.

• Coach engineers and influence across teams to raise the quality bar.

Requirements

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering, including setting strategy for complex backend or data platforms.

• Hands-on experience designing and automating tests for backend and data systems, including API and contract testing, data pipeline validation, and event-driven or streaming interfaces (e.g., Kafka).

• Strong skills in at least one programming language (such as Python, Kotlin/Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Ruby), and comfort working in unfamiliar codebases.

• Deep expertise in test design across unit, API, and end-to-end layers, and judgment about where each belongs. 

• Experience validating data correctness at scale, ideally in matching, identity, or pipeline-driven systems.

• A strong grasp of continuous delivery, CI/CD, and release quality gates.

• A track record of using AI to speed up engineering and testing.

• Proven ability to set d

title: Order Management Operations & Automation
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The ways customers buy from us are multiplying as fast as the business is growing. Enterprise order forms. Private offers through AWS, GCP, and Azure. A self-serve business running on usage-based pricing, with commits, drawdowns, and true-ups behind it. Each one is a distinct path from signature to cash, and each one runs today on some mix of manual steps and automation that grew up with the business.

This role owns what comes next. You'll run order operations end to end - booking, provisioning, invoicing, amendments, and renewals - on a stack we picked deliberately and recently: Salesforce, Metronome for metering and billing, Rillet for ERP. The stack is modern, but the processes on top of it were built to keep up with growth, not designed to scale. Your job is to decide what each one should become: keep it, rebuild it, automate it, or retire it.

Our bias is to invest in systems rather than in a growing queue of manual work, so you'll be setting the automation roadmap at the same time you're operating the function - deciding what a person should touch, what a workflow should handle, and what should never have been a step in the first place. Getting that right is what lets order volume grow by an order of magnitude without ops growing with it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own order operations, working closely with Deal Strategy and Operations, GTM Systems, Finance and Accounting, and Enterprise Engineering. Those teams are your partners and much of your build capacity. Bringing them onto one shared order-to-cash roadmap is a core part of the job, and the reason we're hiring someone senior to do it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the order-to-cash path end to end: order form intake from Deal Desk, booking in Salesforce, plan and entitlement setup in Metronome, invoicing and revenue recognition through Rillet, and the amendments, true-ups, and renewals that follow

- Build out cloud marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure: private offer setup, usage reporting to each marketplace, and reconciling marketplace disbursements back to what we billed. Every new channel launches against defined readiness criteria, so marketplace deals run on the same clean path as direct ones

- Own self-serve billing operations: usage metering, plan changes, dunning, credits, rebills, refunds, and the escalations behind them

- Own billing and usage completeness at month-end close. Every order, credit, and metered event is reconciled between Metronome and Rillet before revenue is recognized, not after

- Partner with Deal Strategy and Product as our pricing evolves. Bring the billing view into pricing and deal-str

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Physical AI)
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI-native startups building in the physical world, across robotics, semiconductors, aerospace, manufacturing, and civil infrastructure, as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build the hardware itself and want Claude woven into how they design, test, and operate it, and others build the software that engineers everywhere use to design, simulate, test, and scale, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup software and hardware engineering teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own engineering with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the physical world. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to build real things, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and helping mechanical, electrical, and process engineers get the kind of step change that software engineering has had from agentic coding with tools like Claude Code.

Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your engineering domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable physical AI startups to succeed with Claude.

Responsibilities

•
Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential startups building in the physical world, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they design, test, and run their own hardware, working alongside them to push the boundaries of AI in engineering, manufacturing, operations, and more

•
Work hands-on with startup software and hardware teams through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their engineering workflows end to end, from design and simulation through test, production, and operations, so that your guidance fits how real hardware gets built

•
Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, benchmarks grounded in real engineering tasks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude

•
Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example integrating Claude with CAD, simulation, design tools, or industrial automation

•
Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements

•
Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about applying AI to physical systems such as reading drawings, 3D geometry, board layout and routing, GD&T, latency and on-premise constraints, and physical safety, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team 

•
Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code

•
Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and startup-focused events

•
Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building

You may be a good fit if you have

•
Deep engineering experience in a physical discipline such as mechanic

title: Site Reliability Engineer
locationText: Los Angeles, United States; San Francisco, United States
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary and Impact

This role is within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in owning production stability, observability, and system health for a mission-critical global campaign governance and compliance platform. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will operate and improve a system running natively on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will investigate complex production issues, implement minor code-level fixes in Python, lead root cause analysis, and improve the reliability of distributed systems. Working closely with the EMEA-based Engineering Tech Lead, Product Owner, and Quality Assurance partners, you will connect production insights with technical roadmap priorities.

The opportunity combines hands-on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) with technical squad leadership. There's an initial monitoring setup to build from, but it's a great opportunity to evaluate what exists, form your own point of view, and define where observability needs to go. From there, you'll shape the future support squad for a dedicated product used across global advertising campaigns, while also owning advanced L2+ and L3-oriented support, incident response, and the service-level and business-as-usual work that keeps the system running.

Key Responsibilities

• Own production stability, system health, and observability for a mission-critical campaign governance and compliance platform running on GCP.

• Define and advance the observability strategy using GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, Prometheus, PromQL, and suitable service level indicators and objectives.

• Lead incident response, post-incident reviews, and end-to-end root cause analysis, partnering with the EMEA Engineering team on permanent remediation.

• Diagnose and resolve complex, intermittent, and high-priority incidents across application, database, infrastructure, and networking layers.

• Read, debug, and implement minor fixes and patches directly within the existing Python production codebase.

• Monitor execution flows, performance, data refreshes, automated checks, and recurring compliance reporting to ensure reliable system operation.

• Identify opportunities to automate manual support activity, develop and maintain runbooks, and reduce operational toil.

• Provide technical leadership to the L2+ support squad through coaching, knowledge sharing, prioritization, and effective handovers.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Quality Assurance teams to assess operational risk, improve release and change management, and influence technical roadmap decisions.

Skills and Experience

• Advanced education in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure/platform engineering roles, including meaningful experience operating and troubleshooting production systems at scale.

• Deep, hands-on experience supporting enterprise systems on Google Cloud Platform, including Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Identity and Access Management, and virtual private cloud networking.

• Strong, current Python proficiency, including the ability to read, debug, and implement fixes directly

title: Model Policy Manager, National Security
description:
About the Team

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives-from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming-all aimed at mitigating misuse, misalignment, and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency. Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations.

Within Safety Systems, the Model Policy team works to ensure that frontier models behave safely and reliably in real-world environments by designing policies that define safe model behavior.

We've had several relevant publications, including:

- Safety at every step https://openai.com/safety/

- OpenAI GPT6 System Card https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-6-astra

- OpenAI Model Spec https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-model-spec/

About the Role

We’re hiring a Model Policy Manager to shape model behavior for U.S. government use, with a focus on national security applications. You’ll define nuanced policies and translate them into training and evaluation criteria, helping models navigate high-stakes scenarios while preserving their usefulness and capabilities.

In this role, you’ll:

- Develop model policies that guide safe and useful behavior.

- Build evaluations, identify policy gaps and model failures, and use findings to improve policies and training.

- Work with research, engineering, and domain experts to support safe, reliable deployment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Bring relevant experience in AI safety, policy, or risk assessment.

- Have strong judgment and can turn complex safety questions into clear, practical policies.

- Have the technical fluency to work hands-on with model data and evaluations.

- Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and the responsible use of AI in safety-critical settings.

Security Requirements

Candidates must be eligible and willing to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. An active clearance is not required at the time of hire, and OpenAI will sponsor the clearance process.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. title: Venture Capital AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from venture capital, from seed to growth stage, who build cap tables, round models and exit waterfalls in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of a Venture Capital Associate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in venture capital, startup finance or venture law, covering seed to growth-stage rounds

- Deep hands-on Excel: cap tables, SAFE and note conversions, liquidation preferences, nested formulas and named ranges

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

title: Field Marketing & Campaigns Manager
description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts - accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, https://www.permitflow.com/blog/permitflow-series-b from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7401703305569275904/, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.

This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.

This is a manager-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.

- Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on-the-ground run of show.

- Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.

- Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high-value attendees.

- Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.

- Partner cross-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.

- Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.

- Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.

- Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.

- Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

WHO YOU ARE

- 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.

- You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.

title: Research Intern, ClickHouse Labs
description:
PROGRAM OVERVIEW

The ClickHouse PhD Research Internship Program offers doctoral students the opportunity to pursue ambitious research alongside ClickHouse Labs researchers and engineers working on some of the most interesting challenges in databases, systems, and data infrastructure.

Research interns join ClickHouse Labs for approximately 10-12 weeks to explore meaningful research questions, develop new ideas, and investigate technologies that have the potential to advance both the broader research community and the future of ClickHouse.

The program is intentionally designed around research collaboration. Interns are paired with experienced researchers and have the opportunity to pursue work that aligns with their academic interests, ongoing research, and areas of interest within ClickHouse Labs. In some cases, an internship may build on research, a prototype, or a system the student has already begun exploring at their university.

We believe the strongest research relationships extend beyond a single summer. Interns may continue their work after returning to their university through academic research, open-source contributions, publications, or other forms of collaboration. Where there is a strong mutual fit, an internship may become the beginning of a longer-term relationship between the researcher, ClickHouse Labs, and the broader academic community.

During their internship, researchers will have the opportunity to work closely with ClickHouse Labs, engage with ClickHouse's open-source technology and engineering community, share their findings, and contribute to the intellectual life of the broader research community.

ClickHouse Labs explores ambitious ideas at the intersection of databases, distributed systems, data infrastructure, and the broader systems research community.

Interns have the opportunity to bring their own research interests and perspectives into ClickHouse Labs while working alongside researchers and engineers who are deeply engaged with both the practical challenges and open research questions shaping the future of data systems.

This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach - generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.

Database Outreach & Reactivation

description:
Du hältst im Vertriebsinnendienst täglich die Fäden zusammen, telefonierst mit Kunden, fasst Angebote nach - und suchst jetzt den nächsten Schritt, bei dem dein Einsatz endlich sichtbar wird?

Standort: 100% Remote | Umfang: 30-40 h / Woche | Montag bis Freitag

Ganz einfach: Wer im Innendienst täglich zwischen Kunden, Außendienst und Lager vermittelt, am Telefon nachhakt und trotzdem nichts aus den Augen verliert, hat genau die DNA, die wir für die Leitung unseres Remote-Callcenters brauchen.

Das Fachwissen bringen wir dir bei. Auch Führungserfahrung brauchst du nicht: Wir zeigen dir Schritt für Schritt, wie du ein Team am Telefon coachst und gut führst. Was man nicht lernen kann: deine Schlagfertigkeit, deine positive Energie und deinen Willen, mehr aus dir zu machen.

Über den Job:
Wir generieren für über 500 Handwerksbetriebe und Küchenstudios im D-A-CH-Raum täglich Anfragen über Social Media. Unser Callcenter ruft diese Interessenten an und qualifiziert sie vor. Für unser zweites, komplett remote arbeitendes Team suchen wir eine Teamleitung, die selbst gerne telefoniert, das Team coacht und vorangeht.
Dein Weg: vom Quereinstieg in die Teamleitung:
1. Ankommen: Du lernst unser System direkt am Telefon kennen und wirst persönlich trainiert.
2. Coachen: Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Call-Reviews und Feedback im Team.
3. Führen: Du leitest das Remote-Team eigenverantwortlich und baust es mit uns aus.
Was Dich bei uns erwartet:

• Strukturiertes Onboarding: Einarbeitungsplan mit persönlichem Training zu Leads, Gesprächsleitfäden und Systemen.

• Führungstraining inklusive: Wir bringen dir bei, wie man coacht, Feedback gibt und ein Team motiviert.

• Klare Abläufe: Saubere Anleitungen und Schulungen, damit jeder weiß, was zu tun ist. Kein Chaos.

• Direkter Draht: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Produktionsleitung. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

• 100% Remote & familiäres Umfeld: Komplett aus dem Homeoffice, mit Verständnis für die Lebensrealität von Familien.

• Fixgehalt + Prämienmodell: Planbares Fixum und Prämie bei Zielerreichung.

• Mitspracherecht & Entwicklung: Du gestaltest mit und hast echte Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten.

• Gesundheitsprogramm: Bikeleasing, höhenverstellbare Schreibtische (auch fürs Homeoffice), ergonomische Stühle, Gesundheitsworkshops.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Selbst telefonieren: Du rufst Interessenten an, qualifizierst sie und machst dem Team vor, wie es geht.

• Coachen: Du führst Call-Reviews durch, gibst Feedback und arbeitest neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein.

• Führen: Du bist Ansprechperson fürs Team, sorgst für Verbindlichkeit und behältst die Kennzahlen im Blick.

• Mitaufbauen: Du hilfst beim Ausbau des Teams, inklusive Bewerbungsgesprächen.

Requirements
Das bringst du mit:

• Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst: oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle mit viel Kundenkontakt am Telefon.

• Schlagfertigkeit & Energie: Du bist am Telefon souverän, positiv und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus dem Konzept bringen.

• Bestimmt & empathisch: Du sagst klar, was Sache ist, und bleibst dabei menschlich.

• Reflektiert & lernbereit: Du kannst Fehler eingestehen und willst dich ständig verbessern.

• Gefühl für Zahlen: Kennzahlen schrecken dich nicht ab, du leitest daraus gern konkrete Schritte ab.

• Rahmen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, ruhiger Arbeitsplatz zuhause mit stabilem Internet, 30-40 h von Montag bis Freitag.

Keine Führungserfahrung? Kein Problem. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst, um ein Team gut zu führen.

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 160 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.
Our Impact
While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,500 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters , we don’t just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.
Our Vision
Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.
Are You Ready?
This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.
Check us out here: Decentralized Masters
The Role

The Marketing Compliance Associate owns pre-launch review and ongoing monitoring of every externally facing marketing and sales asset DM produces - paid ads, VSLs, landing pages, webinar scripts, email and SMS flows, and affiliate-distributed copy. The role exists to keep DM's advertising, earnings claims, and sales-floor language inside FTC, SEC, platform, and financial-promotion rules before anything goes live, and to catch problems fast when something already has.

What will you be doing?
Advertising & Creative Review

• Run a pre-launch compliance review for every external marketing asset: paid social and search ads (Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok), VSLs, landing pages, webinar slides, email sequences, SMS flows, and affiliate-distributed copy.

• Maintain a versioned asset library with compliance notes, approval status, and review history for each piece of marketing collateral.

• Maintain a pre-approved disclaimer and disclosure library, adapted for each placement format (video, email, social, landing page).

• Monitor ad accounts across platforms for compliance posture and coordinate the response to platform reviews, account flags, and takedowns.

Earnings & Claims Standards

• Evaluate every income or earnings claim against the FTC's Guideliness, distinguishing specific income claims, lifestyle claims, and substantiated educational context.

• Audit testimonials across all channels, maintain an approved testimonial library with typicality disclosures on file, and require compliance sign-off before any testimonial runs in paid media.

Sales Floor Compliance

• Review and approve sales webinar scripts and 1:1 sales frameworks before they're used.

• Conduct post-webinar and post-call compliance audits, with structured feedback to sales leadership and individual reps.

• Maintain a living library of approved language and prohibited phrases for the sales floor, and train new hires on it during onboarding.

Channel & Data-Privacy Compliance

• Audit the SMS marketing program for TCPA compliance: consent capture, opt-out handling, frequency disclosures, and content restrictions.

• Review commercial email programs for CAN-SPAM compliance: identification headers, working unsubscribe links, and non-deceptive subject lines.

Regulatory Awareness

• Assist in track the evolving crypto/DeFi regulatory landscape as it bears on market

title: Director of Global Account Management - India
description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Opportunity 
We are looking for a Director of Global Account Management to lead, scale, and inspire our team of 20+ account managers and 3 team managers globally through our next phase of hyper-growth.
JumpCloud is a comprehensive cloud directory platform solving complex IT and cybersecurity challenges for organizations worldwide. Because our platform offers immense expansion potential, we need a revenue-focused leader who thrives in technically advanced environments, is genuinely fascinated by the cybersecurity landscape, and brings a track record of selling or expanding technical products. You don't need to be an engineer, but you must love getting into the weeds of a technical product and understanding how it transforms our customers' security posture.
In this role, you’ll be an active, hands-on leader who leads from the front. When a customer calls, you’re the type of leader who remembers their account context, steps into the trenches alongside your team, and jumps on calls to drive value. You will foster a culture of supportive coaching and continuous growth, pushing your account managers to excel while setting the bar through your own actions.
This role reports directly to the SVP of Global Customer Success and collaborates closely with executive leadership across Product, Marketing, Alliances & Channel, and Professional Services.

#LI-KF1

Where you’ll be working/Location:
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 
This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.
 
Language:
JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 
Why JumpCloud?  
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientat

title: Accenture Construct - Project Scheduler, ANS
description:
You've Never Been Satisfied with "Good Enough."

You didn't get into this to manage one piece of a project. You got into it to change how the world gets built.

At Accenture Construct, that's the job. You'll help deliver the data centers, power grids, rail networks, factories and public infrastructure that keep communities moving - smarter, safer and more sustainably.

You'll work alongside people who think big and act bold: project managers, engineers, technologists and strategists who pair real-world delivery with AI. And you won't be handed a slice of it. We take on whole programs, from early strategy through construction and handover, and we stand behind how they land.

Because “good enough” builds the past. You're here to build what's next.
Visit us here to learn more about ​ Accenture Construct
As Accenture continues to grow, you may see a variety of new career opportunities, and depending on the role and location you may be directed to apply through Accenture LLP or one of our other legal entities - Accenture Construct LLC or Accenture Construct Inc., with benefits varying by country and role, so please check with your recruiter for details.

THE WORK:

• You’ll consult with project managers and technical experts to set up assignments, tasks, and subtasks. You’ll develop, implement, and maintain an effective scheduling management system.

• You’ll coordinate project timelines with internal departments and external stakeholders as well as monitor project timelines and deadlines.

• You’ll identify potential project schedule delays and facilitate intervention in a timely manner.

• You’ll evaluate performance and prepare project progress reports. Must be able to provide Earned Value analysis

• You’ll accommodate updates and changes to project schedules.

• You’ll recommend actions to keep project timelines and deadlines on track.

• You’ll document project scheduling processes and maintain records.

• You’ll develop and provide project schedule related reports including schedule quality assessments, earned value, cashflow forecasts and risks.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

• Bachelors degree in business or technical field and 5- 8 years related scheduling experience, or in lieu of bachelor’s degree, a minimum of 9- 12 years relevant scheduling experience is required. Must show demonstrated experience with cost and resource loading schedules.

• Ability to build a schedule from an estimate, project diagram, or verbal scope of work, demonstrated experience with portfolio level scheduling, extensive experience in schedule planning and management.

• In-depth knowledge of the scope of projects within the utilities industry. Advanced ability to evaluate schedule quality, project progress and facilitate interventions.

• Experience and proficiency in using PC software and mainframe computer applications such as Excel, Access, Power Point, MS Project, Asset suite 8, Primavera P6.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

• Experience with solar and/or battery storage (BESS) installations

• Ability to think analytically, apply sound judgement, and solve problems.

• Able to demonstrate business acumen and communicate effectively across multiple levels, both internally and externally

• Ability to work with project schedule stakeholders to ensure timely schedule updated are received.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

• The biggest builds going. Hyperscale data centers, grid and generation, transit and rail, chip fabs, mines, water. If it's complex and it matters, it's on our list.

• You own the outcome. Not a workstream. Not a deliverable. Whether the program lands.

• AI that shows up on site. Program control that predicts instead of records. You'll use it, and you'll help shape it.

• Scale without the distance. More than 5,000 practitioners across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, on a team small enough that people know your name.

• Serious investment in you. Leadership development, technical upskilling and certification support.

• Work that outlasts you.

title: Junior UX Designer
description:

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™ .
We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).
Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success . The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.
That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.
Role context
We’re looking for a Junior UX Designer with strong fundamentals, positive energy and a genuine desire to grow.
If you enjoy improving digital products, collaborating with others and learning by doing, this role is for you.

• Participating in commercial UX/UI projects from concept to delivery.

• Designing product concepts, wireframes, user flows, prototypes and interfaces.

• Working within an end-to-end digital design process.

• Collaborating closely with other designers and an interdisciplinary team, including researchers, strategists, developers and data analysts.

• Using AI tools thoughtfully to support your design workflow.

• Growing your skills with dedicated mentorship and ongoing support from an experienced designer.

What we are looking for

• Solid understanding of UX fundamentals.

• Ability to create wireframes and simple user flows in Figma.

• First experience in design, such as prototyping, interfaces or research, commercial or non-commercial.

• A portfolio, small is fine, but real.

• Good knowledge of Figma.

• Good command of English, B2/C1+, and Polish.

• Strong communication skills.

• Proactive, disciplined and self-motivated approach to work.

• Fast learner with a “let’s improve it” attitude.

• Comfortable using AI tools smartly, not blindly.

Cooperation terms

• B2B cooperation for independent contractors.

• Suggested commercial range: 5 000 to 7 000 PLN net + VAT per month, depending on experience, expertise, scope and availability.

• Remote cooperation.

• Cooperation in an Apple and Google Workspace-based environment.

• Access to selected project tools, systems and environments where required for project delivery, security or client compliance.

• For long-term B2B collaborators, there may be an option to purchase selected benefits, such as a MultiSport card or enel-med medical packages, on preferential group terms, subject to provider availability and applicable conditions.

• Possibility to cooperate with experienced specialists from strategy, design, research, product, analytics, technology and delivery areas.

• The cooperation is based on agreed project outcomes, delivery quality and clear communication.

title: Renewals Specialist
description:
About Alpine IQ

Alpine IQ (AIQ) was founded in 2019 to help companies make sense of their customer data and turn it into real, measurable outcomes. What started as a focused data-unification platform has evolved into a full suite of tools used by brands, retailers, and digital businesses of every size, from fast-growing startups to global enterprises.

We’re a fully remote team of builders who love turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions. Our products streamline operations, power smarter decision-making, and help businesses create personalized, connected experiences for their customers.

If you’re energized by fast-moving environments, creative challenges, and work that genuinely moves the needle, you’ll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

Retention drives a SaaS business, and we’re looking for an experienced renewals professional to own it. As our Renewal Specialist, you’ll manage the full renewal lifecycle across a book of AIQ customers, from early outreach and risk identification through negotiation and signature. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Finance, and you’ll have a real voice in shaping how AIQ approaches renewals as we scale.

This role is for a seasoned renewals professional who knows what a healthy renewal motion looks like and is ready to bring that expertise to a growing team.

What You’ll Do

• Own renewals end to end for an assigned book of accounts, initiating outreach 90-120 days before term end, preparing quotes, and driving contracts to on-time signature.

• Multithread every account, building relationships beyond your day-to-day contact and getting to the decision makers and economic buyers who sign.

• Negotiate with confidence, including pricing adjustments, multi-year agreements, and renewal terms within approved guidelines, and knowing when to escalate.

• Mitigate churn by spotting risk early through customer data, usage trends, and stakeholder signals, then building and executing save plans before renewals are in jeopardy.

• Forecast accurately by keeping your HubSpot pipeline current weekly: stages, close dates, and risk notes.

• Grow accounts by identifying upsell and expansion opportunities during the renewal window.

• Resolve issues across teams, coordinating with Finance and Billing on invoicing, payment, and contract questions.

• Turn data into insight by tracking renewal rate, net and gross revenue retention, and churn reasons, and sharing what you learn with CS leadership.

• Build the playbook: help shape AIQ’s renewal process through templates, automation, and documentation, bringing best practices from your prior experience.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role is measured by how well you retain and grow AIQ’s revenue, and how reliably you execute. Key measures include:

• Revenue retention: Gross and net revenue retention across your book

• Renewal rate: The share of renewals closed on time, before term end

• Expansion: Upsell and cross-sell revenue closed during the renewal window

• Forecast accuracy: How closely your renewal forecast matches actual results

• Execution: Timely outreach, accurate quotes and contracts, and a current HubSpot pipeline

These measures are defined in the role’s compensation plan and performance scorecard.

What You Bring

• 3-5+ years of experience in a dedicated SaaS renewals role, such as Renewal Specialist or Renewals Manager, with direct ownership of a renewal book and retention targets.

• Strong negotiation skills, with a track record of closing renewals, pricing increases, and multi-year agreements while protecting revenue.

• Proven churn mitigation experience, including identifying at-risk accounts early and turning them around.

• The ability to multithread across customer organizations and get to the decision makers who own the renewal.

• Experience managing a high volume of accounts and contracts with strong accuracy and attention to detail.

title: Account Manager
description:
About Ardent
Ardent Global Logistics is an international freight forwarding and customs brokerage company headquartered in Virginia Beach, Virginia. We move ocean and air freight, clear customs, and handle the trade compliance work behind both for small and mid-sized importers and exporters; the companies the largest forwarders tend to overlook.
Our mission is to enable our customers' business by doing common things in an uncommon way, benefiting everyone we serve.
That sentence is not wall art. We open every Monday morning meeting by reading it out loud, naming one of our culture values, and sharing wins from the week before. The last section of this description explains how we actually work; it matters as much as the bullets above it. Position Summary
The Account Manager owns a portfolio of Ardent accounts operationally and commercially. You are the person the customer calls, and the person Pricing, Operations, and Customs look to for the answer on what that customer expects. You keep rates current, quotes moving, SOPs accurate, and service consistent; and when something goes sideways, you are the one who gets in front of it before the customer has to ask.
This is not a pure sales role and it is not a service desk. You will exercise independent judgment on live accounts and you will execute detailed, process-driven work with your own hands. The people who do well here are comfortable doing both in the same day. What You Will Own
Account ownership and relationships

• Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts, owning day-to-day communication and the quality of every response

• Build relationships at multiple levels and across functions inside each account, not only the person who books the freight; map those contacts and keep the map current

• Act as the customer's internal advocate at Ardent, making sure the right people and resources are pointed at their shipments

• Run proactive outreach: scheduled check-ins, satisfaction monitoring, and a call placed before the customer has a reason to make one

• Support onboarding and implementation for new accounts, from account setup and compliance through the first shipment

Pricing, quoting, and account growth

• Assist with pricing on key accounts; keep rates current and accurate, and make sure they are communicated to Operations and to the customer

• Support the quote-to-booking process end to end, following up on outstanding quotations to gain feedback and close the loop on every quote, won or lost

• Bring pricing options and recommendations to account leadership with the analysis behind them

• Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts into additional services and modes: ocean, air, customs brokerage, drayage, First Sale valuation, and duty recovery

• Identify at-risk accounts early and escalate them with a plan attached, not just a warning

Operational execution and SOP integrity

• Spot-check shipments for SOP compliance; flag recurring customer issues and gaps in the SOPs themselves

• Work with the Customer Experience team to write, maintain, and update customer SOPs and internal documentation so that what we promised is what we do

• Collaborate across Pricing, Operations, Imports, Exports, and Customs to resolve issues and protect service quality

• Maintain and update the preferred agent database so origin partner selection is a decision rather than a guess

• Keep account activity, contacts, and opportunities documented accurately and consistently in GoFreight and HubSpot

Performance, reporting, and business reviews

• Establish and monitor service standards and KPIs with assigned accounts

• Prepare and support quarterly business reviews and other customer-facing materials

• Monitor service quality, identify trends, and bring them to management review with root cause attached, not just symptoms

• Maintain customer success stories for commercial use

• Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives alon

title: General Counsel at amo
description:
amo is a Paris-based consumer social company. We want to build Europe's most ambitious consumer company. Our apps Bump https://get.amo.co/en/bump and Sugar https://get.amo.co/en/sugar are used by millions of people all over the globe.

Location sits at the heart of one of our current products, and privacy, trust and safety are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. We want them handled in a way that speeds the business up.

THE ROLE:

We're hiring our first General Counsel to own amo's legal function end to end. This is a business role, not a support function: you'll work directly with the cofounders, join discussions from the start and work with every team, from Product and Distribution to People, Engineering and Finance.

You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. For everything else, you'll build and run a network of local counsel, with the right firm for each topic and each market, and turn their advice into clear decisions for the team.

HOW WE THINK ABOUT LEGAL:

At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. You'll be judged on what you enable, not on how many memos you write.

- Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast.

- Pragmatic on risk: you know which rules are non-negotiable, where there is room for judgement, and how much risk is worth taking for the business. You give a recommendation, not a list of risks.

- Built for scale: you set up the contracts, policies and processes that enable our growth.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

You'll cover every legal question that comes with scaling a consumer app across markets, working with the right local counsel on each topic:

- Corporate: general corporate, group structure as we expand internationally, BSPCE plans and employee liquidity operations.

- Employment: French labour law across the employee lifecycle, from contracts, immigration and internal rules to terminations.

- Trademarks and IP: our global trademark portfolio: filing strategy, oppositions, watch services and disputes. Patents and content licensing as they come.

- Compliance and data protection: GDPR and location data, protection of minors, DSA, app store policies, consumer law as we monetise. Regulator and law enforcement requests.

- Commercial contracts: vendors and SaaS, partnerships, creator and influencer agreements, advertising, data processing agreements. Templates and a self-serve process so teams can move autonomously.

- Litigation: pre-litigation and litigation across jurisdictions, with outside counsel. Clear risk assessments and options for the cofounders.

- M&A: acquisitions and strategic transactions when the time comes, including due diligence, structuring and integration.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

- Teams ship features, sign deals and expand without waiting on legal.

- The cofounders spend far less time on legal: topics get tracked, briefed and closed without one of them driving each one, and nothing is discovered late.

- The right local counsel is in place for each topic and market, on a budget we control.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- Startup and scaleup experience, at our stage and beyond. 7+ years of legal experience, including a senior in-house role (General Counsel, Deputy GC or Head of Legal) at a tech company. You've lived the stage we're at and the ones after it: later funding rounds, international expansion, fast growth.

- Expert in French and EU law. French legal training, with deep knowledge of French corporate and employment law, GDPR and EU digital regulation. Admission to the bar (CAPA) is a plus.

title: Arabic Speaking Go Coding Evaluation Specialist
description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Language: Arabic

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$22.5-US$37.5 per hour

• Work location: fully remote in Egypt

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Analista de Cobrança (Evictions) [Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência]
description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o  maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal , reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

 

Por que essa vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência? 

O Grupo QuintoAndar está comprometido com a promoção da Inclusão Social e um dos pilares é a representatividade em nossos times. Acreditamos que através da geração de mais oportunidades e de ações intencionais, avançaremos na construção e fortalecimento da inclusão social em nosso ambiente.

Vale ressaltar que para essa vaga o nosso processo seletivo não sofreu alterações de etapas ou formas de avaliação. Entendemos que o recrutamento é uma porta de entrada para a diversidade, sempre atentos ao que nos torna plurais.

 

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• Remote-First:
Atuamos no modelo remote-first , oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Para quem gosta de encontros presenciais, disponibilizamos nosso escritório em São Paulo e coworkings parceiros. Além disso, contamos com o programa Work From Anywhere (WFA), que permite trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar do mundo por até 90 dias no ano.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

A área de Operações de Aluguel (Rent) e Evictions desempenha um papel central na nossa proposta de valor: assegurar a tranquilidade e a garantia de pagamento aos proprietários, ao mesmo tempo em que buscamos soluções justas e humanizadas para quem aluga morar bem. Estamos em um momento crucial de internalização dessa operação, construindo uma nova célula dedicada a contratos de alta complexidade e impacto financeiro, unindo negociações consultivas a novas tecnologias e ferramentas de inteligência artificial.

title: HCM Customer Development Lead/ VBS Developer
description:
Job Title: HCM Customer Development Lead/ VBS DeveloperJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *
Opportunity:
CACI is seeking an HCM Custom Development Lead / VBS Developer to support a large-scale federal HCM modernization program implementing Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple federal agencies. In this role, you will lead a development team responsible for extending Oracle Fusion HCM using Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Oracle APEX, Application Composer, and Page Composer-while strictly enforcing a configuration‑first approach that minimizes custom code. You will design custom page layouts, build extension applications that consume Oracle Fusion REST APIs, develop BI Publisher reports, and manage sandbox environments for safe, compliant development and testing. Your team will ensure all extensions are upgrade‑safe, Section 508 accessible, and aligned with federal security requirements.

The role is remote, with preference for candidates in the DMV area.

Responsibilities:

• Lead a development team of senior, mid‑level, and junior VBS developers in designing and building Oracle Fusion HCM extensions using VBS, APEX, Application Composer, and Page Composer.

• Enforce the configuration‑first principle to ensure custom code is only used when standard Oracle Fusion configuration cannot meet validated requirements.

• Design and develop custom page layouts, embedded applications, and extension UIs in Oracle Fusion HCM using JavaScript, HTML5, and Oracle JET within Visual Builder Studio.

• Build custom REST API integrations for extension applications interfacing with Oracle Fusion HCM business objects and external federal systems via the federal APIM gateway.

• Develop custom reports and data extracts using BI Publisher, including agency‑specific templates, EHRI submissions, and compliance reports following Section 508 output requirements.

• Manage sandbox environments and personalization layers to support safe parallel development, testing, and promotion across development, test, and production tenants.

• Establish and maintain development standards, code reviews, and version control practices for all VBS and APEX extensions to ensure upgrade‑safe, maintainable code.

• Design and implement custom workflow extensions and approval routing for federal HR processes (PAR processing, classification actions, SES pay adjustments) requiring logic beyond standard Oracle capabilities.

• Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technical designs, estimate development effort, and identify development risks during SAFe Agile sprint planning.

• Conduct technical reviews and architecture assessments of proposed customizations, advising the Architecture Review Board on build‑versus‑configure decisions.

• Support production deployments and troubleshoot extension‑related defects, providing L3 technical support during agency go‑live and hypercare.

• Operate independently to analyze and resolve complex functional and technical issues and mentor junior team members.

• Lead small work efforts and technical initiatives, review deliverables, and guide junior consultants on Oracle Fusion HCM best practices.

Qualifications:
Required:

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (US citizenship required).

• Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience; additional experience may substitute for a degree.

• 7+ years of software development experience focused on enterprise application extension and customization.

• 3+ years of hands‑on development experience with Oracle VBS, VBCS, or Oracle APEX in Oracle Cloud HCM or ERP environments.

• Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and RESTful API development/consumption.

• Experience with Oracle Fusion extensibility tools including Application Composer, Page Compose

• Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective action plans for product and process non-conformances.

• Work closely with the Quality & Technical Team on product and packaging testing.

• Provide support for HACCP reassessment and new process development activities.

• Manage FSQA-related on-boarding, ad hoc and annual re-training.

• Assist with internal, CFIA and third-party audits and inspection.

• Act as primary escalation point and back-up to FSQA Manager in their absence.

• Manage team scheduling, attend team meetings, assist in complaint investigations and other tasks as assigned by the FSQA Manager.

• Understanding of HACCP principles, the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations and GFSI schemes.

• Strong leadership and communication skills.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Familiar with MS Office, Google Apps and comfortable learning and using new technology.

• Comfortable working in a deadline-driven and fast-paced environment.
