title: VIRTUAL LEGAL EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
description:
VIRTUAL LEGAL EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 20 Hours/Week
This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.
VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.
We are looking for a skilled Executive Assistant with direct legal experience who can own the client relationship and provide back-office support to attorneys and law firms. You will keep calendars, case files, and deadlines in order for professionals who spend much of their time in court or on the road, so they can focus on their clients’ matters. Self-motivation and professional discipline are essential, because attorneys will rely on you to protect their time and their clients’ confidentiality. Adaptability matters just as much, since the work changes with each firm, practice area, and system you are asked to use.
Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another’s success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.
Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.
EXPECTATIONS
Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive & Professional Manner

• Demonstrate a strong work ethic and positive attitude with attorneys, their clients, court staff, and outside vendors.

• Ensure all communication reflects VaVa’s standards of professionalism and care.

• Actively contribute to a thriving contractor culture by embracing VaVa’s values.

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

• Manage day-to-day account activities reliably, and learn each attorney’s practice, active matters, and working preferences well enough to support them accurately.

• Anticipate client needs and communicate progress consistently so clients always know where deadlines and matters stand.

• Protect attorney-client confidentiality in every task and every tool you use.

• Handle challenges independently without letting quality slip or client confidence waver.

• Track engagement hours and flag early when adjustments are needed to sustain service.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage attorney inboxes by prioritizing and filtering messages from clients, courts, and opposing counsel, drafting responses, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Coordinate attorney calendars across time zones for client meetings, consultations, court appearances, hearings, depositions, and mediations, building in travel and buffer time around court days. Handle itineraries and bookings, and adjust quickly when court schedules change.

• Enter and track court deadlines, statutes of limitations, and filing dates in the calendar and case management system, applying court rules as directed and verified by the attorney, with reminders set and conflicts flagged early.

• Support mobile attorneys with daily briefings before court days, shared calendars, a clear routing system for urgent items, and mobile access to files and client portals, so work continues between court and office.

• Open and maintain matters in the case management system or CRM, including client intake, conflict check data entry, engagement letters, and e-signature tracking, and keep records accurate through data entry, deduplication, cleanup, and import and export mapping.

title: Digital & AI Change Management Lead
description:
Job Description Summary
Interested in making Digital and AI Transformation work for the people who use it every day? As the Digital & AI Change Management Lead, you will lead organizational change activities across Transformation priorities within a global and highly matrixed environment. Your primary goal is to drive faster adoption, higher ultimate utilization of changes, and proficiency with the changes that impact employees who will adopt new ways in their daily work.
This individual contributor role is primarily focused on driving successful organizational adoption, stakeholder alignment, leadership engagement, communication and people readiness across AIS ISC Digital & AI Transformation programs. You will partner across AIS Integrated Supply Chain, IT, and business teams to understand how Digital & AI solutions affect people and their ways of working, ultimately to shape and lead practical plans that bridge and sustain the change for them, so not only solutions are delivered operationally, but also successfully adopted across the organization.
This role is a strong next step for a change, transformation, HR, learning & communications, or operations professional who wants to specialize in Digital and AI adoption. You will build experience across Transformation programs and develop repeatable change practices that sustain value for the business. Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Develop, deliver, and execute on change strategies and integrated plans for AIS ISC Digital and AI transformation initiatives that maximize employee adoption and usage of required changes.

• Promote and apply structured Change Management methodologies, best practices, frameworks and tools across initiatives, covering stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, learning, resistance management, adoption, and sustainment.

• Assess how initiatives affect roles, responsibilities, decision rights, process ownership, and organizational interfaces to translate impact into workforce capability needs and reskilling priorities.

• Build stakeholder strategies and change networks that involve colleagues across regions, segments, and functions, distributing and clarifying ownership for readiness and adoption.

• Equip executives, leaders, and managers with communication materials, talking points, presentations, FAQs and employee engagement content to support employees through change, address concerns, and reinforce new behaviors.

• Coordinate and deliver communications and learning activities that help employees understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to apply new processes, Digital & AI solutions, and operating rhythms. As required, in partnership with AIS Communications and HR teams.

• In partnership with the AIS ISC Business Process CoE, support sustainment by reinforcing process ownership, integrating new practices into operating rhythms, and coordinating handoffs and knowledge transfer.

• Define and deliver adoption measures and reporting routines, connecting transformation progress to business impact, including operational and financial outcomes, in clear, leadership-ready communications.

• Monitor change adoption, engagement, communication effectiveness, and readiness indicators and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

• Facilitate workshops, leadership discussions, stakeholder alignment sessions, and change interventions across Transformation programs, in direct partnership with Transformation Leads.

• Partner with Enterprise Change Management to contribute to the continuous improvement and maturity of Change Management and communication capabilities within the organization.

• Academic degree or equivalent relevant experience in Organization Change Management, Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, Communications or related fields.
